decisive_items: a subserosal uterine fibroid was suspected
attenuation values rising from 20 Hounsfield units (HU) pre-contrast to 70 HU on delayed images
a 7.4 cm nodular solid mass in the same location
response.rationale: The vignette explicitly states a subserosal uterine fibroid was suspected based on location and imaging features, and the mass indents the posterior uterine wall without invasion, consistent with a fibroid. R2 (ovarian tumor) is less likely because the mass is between uterus and rectum and the explicit suspicion is fibroid; R3 (rectal tumor) is contradicted by lack of invasion of adjacent organs.

rejected.why: Location could suggest ovarian tumor, but the explicit suspicion of subserosal uterine fibroid and lack of ovarian-specific features make it less likely.
Mass near rectum but no invasion of adjacent organs contradicts a rectal tumor; imaging features favor uterine fibroid.
